title: Field Coherence Entropy–led Regression Detector for Structured Outputs
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build a detector that flags quality regressions for JSON/structured responses by measuring field-level coherence using entropy and pairwise field mutual information. The detector should attribute regressions to recent model or config deltas (model version, quantization profile, batch configuration, routing policy) and produce prioritized alerts for rollouts and canaries.
motivation: Existing shape/contract monitors catch schema violations but miss subtle semantic drift between related fields (e.g., inconsistent dates, contradictory status+reason). This initiative aims to surface regressions that reduce downstream consumer trust without outright schema breaks.
technical_approach: Instrument per-field token entropy and normalized surprisal over a rolling window of production responses
Calculate pairwise and small-cohort mutual information / conditional entropy for logically linked fields (e.g., status <-> status_reason, amount <-> currency) and surface drops in cohesion
Correlate metric deltas with config/model change events by joining with rollout metadata and model routing logs
Train a lightweight anomaly scorer on pre-rollout baseline to prioritize alerts with precision-oriented thresholds
Expose results in Console as a per-route Field Coherence panel and wire alerts into the existing Regression Alerting pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Detector computes per-field entropy and pairwise coherence metrics on production traffic at 99th percentile latency < 200ms additional overhead
Regression alerts that correlate with a config/model change are generated with precision >= 0.85 on historical annotated regressions dataset
Console shows a Field Coherence view with trendlines, top contributing fields, and associated rollout IDs
Playbook for responding to an alert created and linked; includes automated canary rollback suggestion when confidence > 0.9
Unit + integration tests added for metric calculation and attribution glue code; benchmark for cost overhead documented
implementation_steps: Design metric schema and retention policy (telemetry layer) - infra touchpoint
Add runtime instrumentation hook to emit per-response per-field token statistics
Build aggregation service to compute rolling entropy and pairwise scores (Spark/Sparkless job)
Implement attribution joiner that maps metric deltas to rollout/config events
Create anomaly scoring function and tune thresholds using historical eval sets
Wire detection output into Console and Alerting with links to relevant rollouts and sample payloads
Run a 2-week shadow run against canary traffic and gather precision/recall metrics
Iterate on thresholds and add mitigation automations (canary hold / rollback suggestion)
Ship with docs and runbook for SRE/Support
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: High cardinality of fields across routes leading to noisy signals. Mitigation: allow per-route configuration to select tracked fields and auto-group by semantic tags.
Risk: Attribution false-positives when multiple rollouts overlap. Mitigation: use time-decay weighting and require consistency across multiple nearby deltas before high-confidence alerts.
Risk: Cost of storing token-level stats. Mitigation: aggregate to fixed buckets and cap retention to 30 days for detailed metrics, with downsampled longer-term summaries.
Risk: Model-internal sampling or non-determinism creating entropy variance. Mitigation: baseline with simulated temperature/random-seed sweeps during onboarding of each model variant.
test_plan: Create synthetic regression scenarios (contradictory fields injected) and validate detector raises alerts
Replay historical incidents through shadow pipeline to measure precision/recall against labeled set
Performance test aggregation job on expected 1M responses/day traffic profile
Run AB of thresholds on canary vs production for two weeks before enabling automated mitigations
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal run in staging for instrument validation (week 1)
Phase 1: Shadow run on 5% of production routes, collect metrics (weeks 2-3)
Phase 2: Pilot on 25% of traffic with alerting to oncall but no automated actions (weeks 4-5)
Phase 3: Full coverage with optional automated rollback suggestions (week 6)
Post-ship: Monthly tuning and add route presets for common app patterns
